relics.name: Blessed Pollen
relics.desc: Pollen blessed with nature’s harmony, its essence fortifies the bearer with gentle resilience

relics.name: Brash's Kiss
relics.desc: The mysterious Brash is much more cunning and powerful than she lets on

relics.name: Cloud Cake
relics.desc: The clouds surrounding the very peak of Monk's Mountain provide incredible sustenance

relics.name: Dark Owlie Feather
relics.desc: This feather was shed by Dark Owlie during flight, and found near the peaks of Mount Gemma

relics.name: Elefauna Flower
relics.desc: This lucky charm has to be picked from an Elefauna right before evolution

relics.name: Eternal Falls Mushroom
relics.desc: The enduring mushrooms that grow behind the Eternal Falls are nearly impossible to obtain

relics.name: Frost Root
relics.desc: A rare root from the frozen wastelands, warding off the embrace of slumber

relics.name: GK's Slippers
relics.desc: Legendary slippers stolen from GK's Palace, imbued with untold speed

relics.name: Lake Azore Pearl
relics.desc: A rare pearl from the bottom of Lake Azore

relics.name: Pamboo Cane
relics.desc: A cane radiating the sea's healing power, its touch revives vitality as in the days of ancient healers

relics.name: Quartex Crystal
relics.desc: Crystal with a chilling energy that freezes the mind, protecting against confusion

relics.name: Skelepup's Spark
relics.desc: Skelepup's Spark contains a concentrated jolt of power that revs up your Miscrit

relics.name: Woodsman's Axe Head
relics.desc: One of the famous Woodsman's Axe heads. Still sharp

relics.name: Bean Stalk
relics.desc: This relic is made from a fragment of the Aerobian Bean Stalk

relics.name: Elemental Explosion
relics.desc: An artifact holding the fury of elements. Its tempestuous power amplifies elemental force

relics.name: Emerald Scales
relics.desc: These gem scales were shed by the powerful Patrik, and are impressively tough

relics.name: Flower of Despair
relics.desc: A bloom exuding mysterious power. Its dark energy sharpens the wielder’s strength

relics.name: Forest Banner
relics.desc: This banner is given to the new Forest Guard upon completion of their training

relics.name: Forging Hammer
relics.desc: The constant clanging from the Forging Hammer will make any Miscrit a bit irascible

relics.name: Frozen Claws
relics.desc: Shards of frost-bound power and warmth. Their presence fortifies the body against all harm

relics.name: Helzbelz Bells
relics.desc: The ringing of the Helzbelz Bell awakens something deep within a Miscrit

relics.name: Jungle Banner
relics.desc: This banner is carried by the fearless Guard of the Miscrian Jungle

relics.name: Monk's Mountain Banner
relics.desc: The frigid cold of Monk's Mountain requires good health and good physical condition

relics.name: Monk's Robe
relics.desc: The Monk's Robe hides something terribly powerful inside

relics.name: Mt. Gemma Banner
relics.desc: The rocky terrain of Mt. Gemma requires one to be an excellent climber and fleet of foot

relics.name: Nero's Orb
relics.desc: This orb, once played with by a young Nero, was found in a Monk's Mountain cave

relics.name: Obsidian Lava
relics.desc: This relic has been infused with the same lava that flows through Obsidape's paws

relics.name: Ship Captain's Log
relics.desc: This is a journal kept by the captain of the ship between Volcano Island and Sunfall Kingdom

relics.name: Skyline Peak Gem
relics.desc: Chiseled from the famous golden gem atop Skyline Peak

relics.name: Stony Shield
relics.desc: A shield crafted from lava rocks pulled straight from the Volcano itself

relics.name: Sunfall Shores Banner
relics.desc: This banner is carried by the Guard of Sunfall Shores

relics.name: Volcano Banner
relics.desc: The harsh environment of the Volcano requires one to be of strong stock

relics.name: Arrow of Love
relics.desc: This arrow from Valentino's quiver contains the ultimate power of love

relics.name: Bauble of the Dawn
relics.desc: The Bauble of the Dawn fills any Miscrit that wears it with pure energy, giving them an extra boost

relics.name: Cactus Flower
relics.desc: A flower from one of the hardy, spiny cacti of Mount Gemma

relics.name: Dark Warro Thorn
relics.desc: Thorns dropped by Dark Warro are rare and highly valued

relics.name: Dragon Shackle
relics.desc: Proof from deep inside Volcano Island that dragons once existed

relics.name: Echino Shell
relics.desc: This shell hardened from battle, has a varied effect on Miscrits

relics.name: Everlasting Snowball
relics.desc: This snowball manages to remain chilly to the touch even in bright sunlight

relics.name: Fractured Shell
relics.desc: The Fractured Shell is shed by Fracture as it matures, but it maintains an aura of magic

relics.name: Geotoad Teeth
relics.desc: This relic is crafted from the chips of Geotoad Teeth that are mined in Mount Gemma

relics.name: Gold Piece Die
relics.desc: The Gold Piece Die is a magical device that is powered by pure strength

relics.name: Gravitron Pebble
relics.desc: This pebble floats with a mysterious other-worldly energy

relics.name: Lost Swords
relics.desc: These swords survive as relics from an earlier age of Miscria

relics.name: Magicite Staff
relics.desc: The mysterious floating stones on top of the Magicite Staff contain great and terrible power

relics.name: Monastery Idol
relics.desc: An idol found in Volcano Island, infused with vitality and resilience

relics.name: Mushles
relics.desc: A peculiar relic whispering otherworldly secrets, found in hidden forests

relics.name: Mystic Map
relics.desc: This Mystic Map was a gift from a traveler, and no one knows where it leads

relics.name: Nanaslug's Horn
relics.desc: This slimy, sludgy horn of Nanaslug increases both Health and Elemental Attack

relics.name: Nox's Nightmare
relics.desc: After exhaustive research by the Miscrian Scholars, they found this relic to help in the battle against Apollo Nox

relics.name: Palmda's Talon
relics.desc: Palmda's Talon is impossibly sharp, and makes any physical attack more powerful

relics.name: Papa's Antlers
relics.desc: The protective strength of Papa lies deep within these sacred antlers

relics.name: Patchkin's Rind
relics.desc: The source of the haunting Patchkin's power

relics.name: Peepsie Eggs
relics.desc: Peepsie Eggs are extremely colorful and sweet

relics.name: Shackler's Gem
relics.desc: Provides great protection to its bearer

relics.name: Shard of Dawn's Landing
relics.desc: The Shard of Dawn's Landing is a stream of pure light energy that has been crafted into a solid object

relics.name: Shattered Gatestone
relics.desc: The Shattered Gatestone is made of some of the hardest material ever found in Miscria

relics.name: Temple Stone
relics.desc: This stone, obtained from the crumbling Temple walls, contains deep magic

relics.name: Tiki Idol
relics.desc: The Tiki Idol from the Enchanted Tiki Island has been worshipped for many generations

relics.name: Truncherous Hammer
relics.desc: This brutally powerful relic is difficult for most Miscrits to carry

relics.name: Vanquished Soul
relics.desc: This relic was found in the Volcano, and is believed to be the spiritual remnants of an ancient Miscrit

relics.name: Cage of Despair
relics.desc: This cage is symbolic of the hardships of Miscrits throughout the world

relics.name: Charcoal Idol
relics.desc: No one is sure if the Charcoal Idol was an object of worship or simply a child's doll that has been badly charred

relics.name: Dark Wind's Venom
relics.desc: Dark Wind's Venom is extracted from its killer fangs, then morphed into a powerful relic

relics.name: Flying Carpet Fragment
relics.desc: Torn from the corner of an Aerobian carpet and made into a powerful relic

relics.name: Frozen Coin
relics.desc: This coin was found on an expedition to the mysterious Ice Tower

relics.name: Gog's Cog
relics.desc: This rugged part from complex innards of Gog gives him incredible physical strength

relics.name: Leggy Eggs
relics.desc: The eggs from Leggy found in Sunfall Shores have an incredibly hard shell

relics.name: Molten Coin
relics.desc: This molten coin from deep within the Fountain of Doom is dangerously powerful

relics.name: Moon Rock
relics.desc: This rock, pulled from the surface of the Moon of Miscria, is nearly indestructible

relics.name: Petrified Dragon Egg
relics.desc: No one knows how to reawaken this egg, though many have tried to harness its magic

relics.name: Petrified Mama Baby
relics.desc: This Petrified Mama baby relic was uncovered during a Volcano dig

relics.name: Saiyam's Trident
relics.desc: This magical trident contains a spell to increase strength

relics.name: Scent of Skustunk
relics.desc: The Scent of Skustunk is at once mystifying, horrifying, and intriguing

relics.name: Shard of Rudolffe
relics.desc: This ancient shard is imbued with magic and the power to enhance
